title: Plurals: A System for Guiding LLMs Via Simulated Social Ensembles

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring output homogenization and viewpoint collapse by comparing the lexical diversity (TTR, HD-D) of model responses on political issues (e.g., abortion, gun control) when using single-attribute ideological personas versus intersectional demographic personas. Additionally, using human evaluation to assess how well model-generated policy proposals resonate with specific political audiences (liberals and conservatives).
